products.name: Holistic AI
products.note: Bias auditing, risk management, compliance; strong technical depth; mid-market focus

profile_text.body:
Holistic AI is an enterprise software company that describes itself as a provider of an end-to-end AI governance platform. The platform is designed to help organizations discover every AI system in use, including shadow AI running across cloud platforms, code repositories, and SaaS applications, assess and monitor those systems for risk and bias on a continuous basis, and enforce regulatory compliance across models, agents, and applications. The company says the platform includes built-in frameworks for the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and NYC Local Law 144, along with automated control mapping, gap analysis, and audit evidence collection. It also describes an agentic AI supervisory layer that observes behavior and intervenes in real time when risk thresholds are crossed.

The company's core product, tracked under the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category, covers bias auditing, risk management, and compliance with a noted focus on the mid-market. The site cites recognition from Gartner, Everest Group, CB Insights, Avasant, and Forrester for its governance capabilities and market presence. Unilever is quoted on the site describing Holistic AI's platform as central to its Responsible AI strategy, and MindBridge is also cited as a customer referencing the value of independent AI assurance.

The held facts do not include litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations for Holistic AI.
